anchor: Bajaj RE 4S auto rickshaw: 2635 x 1300 x 1700 mm, wheelbase 2000 mm. No real badges or logos; plate is fictional (KJA 208).

atlas.compression: KTX2 ETC1S for all three maps (colour limited to 768 px, normal and ORM to 576 px during compression), geometry Meshopt (EXT_meshopt_compression) via gltfpack 1.3 with -kn so named nodes survive
atlas.ingredients: CC0 surface detail (ambientCG Rubber004, PaintedMetal004, Leather026, Fabric030) baked into the atlas in Blender; no raw texture files ship
atlas.maps: one 1024 atlas baked in Blender: baseColor (sRGB) + tangent-space normal + packed ORM (R=occlusion, G=roughness, B=metallic); the occlusion slot shares the ORM texture, verified in the exported JSON

decoders: shared self-hosted set under /decoders (meshopt_decoder.js, babylon.ktx2Decoder.js, ktx2Transcoders/1/*), configured by the heroes.ts loader block from the danfo integration
integration: proof/keke-heroes.patch.txt (danfo-style async swap in buildKeke; primitive keke stays as fallback on any load failure)
livery: Lagos yellow paint with green waist stripe and green canopy, worn and dusted, baked in

nodes.body: named transform node: paint, cabin, seats, hardware (atlas material)
nodes.canopy: named transform node: fabric canopy shell with seams, lip roll and rear valances (atlas material), separate for later material touches
nodes.note: gltfpack -kn splits each named object into a named transform node with an unnamed mesh child (quantization compensation transform on the child). Babylon loads the names onto TransformNodes; the wheels are collected from container.transformNodes in the patch.
nodes.windshield: named transform node: tinted glass, alpha 0.78, BLEND, kept out of the atlas material

source: assets-src/keke/keke.blend, built by assets-src/keke/build_keke.py (Blender 4.2.3 LTS); uncompressed export at assets-src/keke/keke.glb
units: metres, as exported. Front of the vehicle faces +Z in glTF and Babylon space, matching the heroes.ts convention.
